1.text: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, N Timothy our brother, 2 Philemon our dearly beloved, N fellowlabourer,
N 2 our beloved Apphia, N Archippus our fellowsoldier, N 2 tha church in ur house:
Grace 2 u, N peace, from God our Father N tha Lord Jesus Christ.
I thank my God, makin mention of u always in my prayers,
Hearin of ur love N faith, which u have toward tha Lord Jesus, N toward all saints;
Dat tha communication of ur faith may become effectual by tha acknowledging of every good thing which is in u in Christ Jesus.
4 we have great joy N consolation in ur love, because tha bowels of tha saints r refreshed by u, brother.
So, though I might be much bold in Christ 2 enjoin u dat which is convenient,
Yet 4 love’s sake I rather beg u, bein such an one as Paul tha aged, N now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
I beg u 4 my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
Which in time past was 2 u unprofitable, but now profitable 2 u N 2 me:
Whom I have sent again: u therefore receive him, dat is, my own bowels:
Whom I would have retained wit me, dat in ur stead he might have ministered 2 me in tha bonds of tha gospel:
But without ur mind would I do nothing; dat ur benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
4 perhaps he therefore departed 4 a season, dat u should receive him 4 ever;
Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially 2 me, but how much more 2 u, both in tha flesh, N in tha Lord?
If u count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
If he has wronged u, or oweth u ought, put dat on mine account;
I Paul have written it wit my own hand, I will repay it: even though I do not say 2 u how u owest 2 me even ur own self besides.
Yeah, brother, let me have joy of u in tha Lord: refresh my bowels in tha Lord.
Havin confidence in ur obedience I wrote 2 u, knowin dat u will also do more than I say.
But withal prepare me also a lodging: 4 I trust dat through ur prayers I shall be given 2 u.
There greet u Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
Tha grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be wit ur spirit. Amen.
